title: Implement the appbuilder build validation gate
description: In cli/lib/build.js, implement the default build(cwd, slug) gate: manifest exists and is schema-valid; manifest ids exactly match task-plan ids; no task pending; each done task lists >=1 file that exists under build/<slug>/; each skipped task has a non-empty reason; scaffold-report rendered_files still exist. On pass, write a schema-valid build/<slug>/build-report.json (counts + sorted files_touched). On failure, print fail build: lines, exit 1, write nothing. Test-first.
acceptance_criteria: A fully-done manifest passes and writes a schema-valid build-report.json.
pending tasks, missing declared files, reasonless skips, mismatched ids, and deleted scaffold files each fail the gate with a clear message and no report written.
